verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents deletion and retrieval APIs meant to help implementations meet GDPR requirements, so programmatic deletion of user data is supported. Nothing in the evidence shows controls for how long data is retained. The Retention report is an engagement metric, and the warehouse retention notes concern Snowflake and Databricks settings, so neither counts as data-retention control. Missing for 10: configurable data retention periods, details of deletion scope and turnaround, deletion through the MCP server or other AI-native tooling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
